summary: This function iterates over the response data, one line at a time, when stream=True is set on the request. It avoids reading the content at once into memory for large responses. The function is not reentrant safe.
risk_assessment: Low risk of technical debt impact, as the function is not reentrant safe and has a low cyclomatic complexity. However, it is worth considering refactoring the function to improve maintainability and readability.
